scenario: `(a.lo..a.hi) contains (b.lo..b.hi)` over two `Int` intervals is `Bool` (LINT.3.2.1), and both element types match (LINT.3.2.2), so it compiles as a `where`. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: no containment is evaluated.
rules_ds:
schema Span scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    lo: Int mutable
    hi: Int mutable

rule r:
    Span a where a.entity_id == "outer"
    Span b where b.entity_id == "inner" and (a.lo..a.hi) contains (b.lo..b.hi)
->
    log info "inner is subset"
